sources.title: MPA: Multimodal Prototype Augmentation for Few-Shot Learning
sources.snippet: Recently, few-shot learning (FSL) has become a popular task that aims to recognize new classes from only a few labeled examples and has been widely applied in fields such as natural science, remote sensing, and medical images.
